text.en: Exploring the next generation of generative intelligence.
text.zh: 探索下一代生成式智能。

statementHtml.en:
More efficient intelligence.
Broader real-world adoption.
statementHtml.zh:
更高效的智能
才能推动更广泛的落地。

descriptionHtml.en: Senior Research Scientist at hi-lab, Xiaohongshu. Exploring next-generation paradigms for efficient, intelligent foundation models.
descriptionHtml.zh: 小红书 hi-lab 高级研究科学家。探索下一代高效，智能的基础模型范式。

portraitAlt.en: Portrait of Weijian Luo outdoors by the San Francisco Bay
portraitAlt.zh: Weijian Luo 在旧金山湾畔的照片

intro.en: More capable intelligence with less compute, making superintelligence accessible to all.
intro.zh: 以更少计算，释放更强智能，让超级智能触手可及。

description.en: Efficient foundation models that understand, reason, and create across modalities, exploring a path toward superintelligence.
description.zh: 研究具备跨模态理解、推理与创造能力的高效基础模型，探索通往超级智能的路径。

titleHtml.zh:
从扩散模型，
到一步生成。

description.en: Efficient one-step text-to-image and video generation, making superintelligence widely accessible through a thousandfold gain in efficiency.
description.zh: 探索高效的一步文生图与视频生成，用千倍的效率普及超级智能。

description.en: Aligning generative models with rewards from the environment through reinforcement learning and feedback.
description.zh: 通过强化学习与反馈，让生成式模型更好地对齐环境回报。

descriptionHtml.en: Weijian's early work laid the theoretical and practical foundations for modern one-step text-to-image models. He currently leads the research team on large-scale generative understanding models at hi-lab, developing efficient models that reason, understand human intent, and generate visual and audio responses in real time. He also leads research on next-generation generative models, including large-scale one-step text-to-image and video generation.
descriptionHtml.zh: Weijian 的早期工作为现代一步文生图模型的理论与实践奠定了基础。目前，他在 hi-lab 带领大规模生成式理解模型研究团队，致力于开发高效的生成式理解模型，使其具备推理能力、理解人类意图，并实时生成视觉与音频响应。他也负责下一代生成式模型的研究方向，包括大规模一步文生图与视频生成模型。

titleHtml.zh:
数学物理背景，
大模型研发。

biographyHtml.en: Weijian is a RedStar Senior Research Scientist at the Humane Intelligence (hi) lab of Xiaohongshu (RedNote). He currently leads the research team on large-scale generative understanding foundation models at hi-lab. He earned his PhD in Statistics and Generative Modeling from the School of Mathematical Sciences at Peking University, where he previously received an MS in Applied Statistics. He holds a BS in Mathematics from the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC).
biographyHtml.zh: Weijian 现任小红书（RedNote） Humane Intelligence（hi）实验室的 RedStar 高级研究科学家。目前，他在 hi-lab 带领大规模生成式理解基础模型研究团队。他于北京大学数学科学学院获得统计学与生成建模方向博士学位，此前亦在北京大学数学科学学院获得应用统计学硕士学位，并于中国科学技术大学（USTC）获得数学学士学位。

serviceHtml.en: Weijian serves as a reviewer for academic journals including Nature Communications (NC), Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR), IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI), IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP), IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS), and Pattern Recognition (PR). He also reviews for AI conferences including NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, AISTATS, UAI, and ACM-MM.
serviceHtml.zh: Weijian 受邀担任多个学术期刊的审稿人，包括 Nature Communications （NC）、Journal of Machine Learning Research （JMLR）、IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence （TPAMI）、IEEE Transactions on Image Processing （TIP）、IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems （TNNLS），以及 Pattern Recognition （PR）。他也为 NeurIPS、ICML、ICLR、CVPR、ICCV、AISTATS、UAI、ACM-MM 等人工智能领域会议审稿。

descriptionHtml.en: Weijian's team in Beijing is recruiting research scientists and engineers. Candidates with a strong research background and an interest in next-generation generative understanding models are welcome to apply to the RedStar Research Scientist program or the ACE internship program.
descriptionHtml.zh: Weijian 在北京的团队正在招募有才华的研究科学家和工程师。欢迎拥有扎实研究积累、对下一代生成式理解模型充满好奇的候选人，申请 RedStar 研究科学家计划或 ACE 实习生计划。
